arxiv-1703-01089.title: Rainbow Neighbourhoods of Graphs
arxiv-1703-01089.creator: Johan Kok, Sudev Naduvath, Muhammad Kamran Jamil
arxiv-1703-01089.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Johan Kok, Sudev Naduvath, Muhammad Kamran Jamil. In this paper, we introduce the notion of the rainbow neighbourhood and a related graph parameter namely the rainbow neighbourhood number and report on preliminary results thereof. The closed neighbourhood N ⁡ [ v ] N[v] of a vertex v ∈ V ⁡ ( G ) v\in V(G) which contains at least one coloured vertex of each colour in the chromatic colouring of a graph is called a rainbow neighbourhood.

arxiv-2207-11053.title: Evidence of A C ​ P ​ ( D 0 → π + ​ π − ) A_{CP}(D^{0}\to\pi^{+}\pi^{-}) implies observable C ​ P CP asymmetry in the D 0 → π 0 ​ π 0 D^{0}\to\pi^{0}\pi^{0} decay
arxiv-2207-11053.creator: Di Wang
arxiv-2207-11053.description: Abstract Inspired by the recent measurement of C ​ P CP asymmetry in the individual mode on LHCb, we study C ​ P CP asymmetry of the D → π ​ π D\to\pi\pi system in the isospin and topological analysis.

arxiv-2212-11998.title: The Supergeometric Algebra
arxiv-2212-11998.creator: Andrew J. S. Hamilton
arxiv-2212-11998.description: Abstract . Spinors are central to physics: all matter (fermions) is made of spinors, and all forces arise from symmetries of spinors. It is common to consider the geometric (Clifford) algebra as the fundamental edifice from which spinors emerge. This paper advocates the alternative view that spinors are more fundamental than the geometric algebra.

arxiv-2303-03644.title: Quantifying separability in limit groups via representations
arxiv-2303-03644.creator: Keino Brown, Olga Kharlampovich
arxiv-2303-03644.description: Abstract We show that for any finitely generated subgroup H H of a limit group L L there exists a finite-index subgroup K K containing H H , such that K K is a subgroup of a group obtained from H H by a series of extensions of centralizers and free products with ℤ \mathbb{Z} .

arxiv-2303-13205.description: Abstract In this work we present the highest spatial and spectral resolution integral field observations to date of the bipolar jet from the Orion proplyd 244-440 using Multi-Unit Spectroscopic Explorer (MUSE) narrow-field mode (NFM) observations on the Very Large Telescope (VLT).

arxiv-2311-18421.title: Dynamical Implications of the Kerr Multipole Moments for Spinning Black Holes arXiv: 2311.18421
arxiv-2311-18421.creator: T. Scheopner, and J. Vines
arxiv-2311-18421.description: Abstract Previously the linearized stress tensor of a stationary Kerr black hole has been used to determine some of the values of gravitational couplings for a spinning black hole to linear order in the Riemann tensor in the action (worldline or quantum field theory).

arxiv-2401-12243.title: Bounded-Error Policy Optimization for Mixed Discrete-Continuous MDPs via Constraint Generation in Nonlinear Programming
arxiv-2401-12243.creator: Michael Gimelfarb, Ayal Taitler, Scott Sanner
arxiv-2401-12243.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Michael Gimelfarb, Ayal Taitler, Scott Sanner. We propose the Constraint-Generation Policy Optimization (CGPO) framework to optimize policy parameters within compact and interpretable policy classes for mixed discrete-continuous Markov Decision Processes (DC-MDP). CGPO can not only provide bounded policy error guarantees over an infinite range of initial states for many DC-MDPs with expressive nonlinear dynamics, but it can also provably derive optimal policies in cases where it terminates with zero error.

arxiv-2402-07398.title: VisLingInstruct: Elevating Zero-Shot Learning in Multi-Modal Language Models with Autonomous Instruction Optimization
arxiv-2402-07398.creator: Dongsheng Zhu 1 , Xunzhu Tang 2 , Weidong Han 3 , Jinghui Lu 4 , Yukun Zhao 1 , Guoliang Xing 1 , Junfeng Wang 1 , Dawei Yin ∗ 1 1 Baidu Inc., 2 University of Luxemburg 3 Fudan University, 4 University College Dublin {zhudongsheng, yindawei02}@baidu.com xunzhu.tang@uni.lu, wdhan20@fudan.edu.cn
arxiv-2402-07398.description: Abstract This paper presents VisLingInstruct, a novel approach to advancing Multi-Modal Language Models (MMLMs) in zero-shot learning. Current MMLMs show impressive zero-shot abilities in multi-modal tasks, but their performance depends heavily on the quality of instructions. VisLingInstruct tackles this by autonomously evaluating and optimizing instructional texts through In-Context Learning, improving the synergy between visual perception and linguistic expression in MMLMs.

arxiv-2501-04403.title: Rising Rested MAB with Linear Drift
arxiv-2501-04403.creator: Omer Amichay, Yishay Mansour
arxiv-2501-04403.description: Abstract We consider non-stationary multi-arm bandit (MAB) where the expected reward of each action follows a linear function of the number of times we executed the action. Our main result is a tight regret bound of Θ ~ ​ ( T 4 / 5 ​ K 3 / 5 ) \tilde{\Theta}(T^{4/5}K^{3/5}) , by providing both upper and lower bounds.

arxiv-2502-10324.title: Analysis and Prediction of Coverage and Channel Rank for UAV Networks in Rural Scenarios with Foliage
arxiv-2502-10324.creator: Donggu Lee, Ozgur Ozdemir, Asokan Ram, Ismail Guvenc
arxiv-2502-10324.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Donggu Lee, Ozgur Ozdemir, Asokan Ram, Ismail Guvenc. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are expected to play a key role in 6G-enabled vehicular-to-everything (V2X) communications requiring high data rates, low latency, and reliable connectivity for mission-critical applications. Multi-input multi-output (MIMO) technology is essential for meeting these demands. However, UAV link performance is significantly affected by environmental factors such as signal attenuation, multipath propagation, and blockage from obstacles, particularly dense foliage in rural areas.

arxiv-2502-18023.title: Detecting Knowledge Boundary of Vision Large Language Models by Sampling-Based Inference
arxiv-2502-18023.creator: Zhuo Chen, Xinyu Wang, Yong Jiang, Zhen Zhang, Xinyu Geng, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang, Kewei Tu
arxiv-2502-18023.description: Abstract Despite the advancements made in Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs), like text Large Language Models (LLMs), they have limitations in addressing questions that require real-time information or are knowledge-intensive. Indiscriminately adopting Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques is an effective yet expensive way to enable models to answer queries beyond their knowledge scopes.

pmc-11524696.title: Extracellular Traps in Patients Diagnosed With Bacterial Vaginosis, Trichomoniasis, Candidiasis, Noninfectious Vaginitis and Cytolytic Vaginosis
pmc-11524696.creator: María G. Ramírez-Ledesma, Berenice Bermudes-Valencia, Rosa M. Balderas-Parada, Susana G. Salazar-Ramírez, Ruth Reyes-Cortés, Francisco J. Magos-Vázquez, José J. Torres-Hernández, Eva E. Avila
pmc-11524696.description: Vaginal infections are a public health problem associated with serious health complications due to the exacerbated inflammation they generate. Vaginal inflammation may also occur in some noninfectious processes, such as noninfectious vaginitis and cytolytic vaginosis. Immune system cells respond to infections through various mechanisms, such as the formation of extracellular traps (ETs), which are DNA networks associated with effector proteins.

pmc-11673972.title: Sample Preparation for Metabolomic Analysis in Exercise Physiology
pmc-11673972.creator: Valeriya I. Nakhod, Tatiana V. Butkova, Kristina A. Malsagova, Denis V. Petrovskiy, Alexander A. Izotov, Kirill S. Nikolsky, Anna L. Kaysheva
pmc-11673972.description: Metabolomics investigates final and intermediate metabolic products in cells. Assessment of the human metabolome relies principally on the analysis of blood, urine, saliva, sweat, and feces. Tissue biopsy is employed less frequently. Understanding the metabolite composition of biosamples from athletes can significantly improve our knowledge of molecular processes associated with the efficiency of training and recovery.

pmc-12699849.title: Epidemiological profile and transmission of mpox in the Kamituga health zone of South Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo: a cross-sectional prospective study
pmc-12699849.creator: Léandre Mutimbwa Mambo, Gaylord Amani Ngaboyeka, Emmanuel Ongezi Lurhangire, Armand Mulume Bisimwa, Moise Musafiri Namegabe, Ghislain Bisimwa Balaluka, Michel P. Hermans, Pacifique Mwene-Batu
pmc-12699849.description: BackgroundMonkeypox (mpox) remains a major global public health problem due to its rapid transmission, clinical severity and high case-fatality rate, especially for the clade I virus. Since August 2024, the disease was declared an public health emergency of international concern, with the resurgence of the disease cases and morbidity and mortality. Few studies exist in low-income countries.

pmc-13032180.title: The efficacy of acetic acid and citric acid on calcium silicate based cement removal from root canals and their effect on dentine structure – an in vitro study
pmc-13032180.creator: Hanan Alzraikat, Ahmad S Al-Hiyasat, Estabraq Sarya Jamous, Mohammad A Alebrahim
pmc-13032180.description: ObjectivesThis study evaluated the effectiveness of acids on calcium silicate cement surface hardness, perforation, and their impact on root dentine microstructure.Materials and methodsRoot dentine discs were exposed to hydrochloric, acetic, and citric acids. Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) assessed dentine microstructure after exposure to these acids.

pmc-13240378.title: A Case of Nonimmune Hydrops Fetalis With a Duct‐Dependent Systemic Circulation and a Novel Mutation of Kabuki Syndrome
pmc-13240378.creator: Rameshwar Prasad, Sudipta Sahoo, Richie Dalai, Keshav Kumar Pathak, Bhabesh Kant Chowdhary
pmc-13240378.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionNonimmune hydrops fetalis (NIHF) has numerous etiologies, the most common of which are cardiac anomalies and fetal infection. However, genetic disorders are also being increasingly recognized as a cause of NIHF. Here, we report a case of a neonate presenting with polyhydramnios, NIHF, structural heart disease, and diaphragmatic defect who was found to have a previously unreported mutation in the KMT2D gene.Case PresentationA female neonate with antenatally detected NIHF was born at 35 weeks of gestation via cesarean section.

pmc-13398691.title: Successfully performed video capsule endoscopy in an 8‐month‐old infant weighing 7.5 kg
pmc-13398691.creator: Paul‐Christoph Zeisler, Robert Thimme, Ulrike Teufel‐Schaefer, Michael Schultheiß
pmc-13398691.description: Video capsule endoscopy (VCE) is a well‐established diagnostic tool for examining the small bowel. Limited data exist on its use in infants. To our knowledge, we present the first detailed case of a successful PillCam®SB3‐VCE performed in an 8‐month‐old infant weighing 7.5 kg with suspected small bowel bleeding following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
